'''Red''' is the name of a horse given to [[Rand al'Thor]] by [[Basel Gill]].

==Appearance==
Red is a tall bay stallion with a deep chest. His hair is almost the color of Rand's hair.

==Activities==
Basel Gill gives Rand Red to make the journey from [[Caemlyn]] to [[Fal Dara]].{{ref/book|1|44}} Red carries Rand from [[Fal Dara]] on his hunt for the [[Horn of Valere]] and the [[ruby-hilted dagger]].{{ref/book|2|9}} Rand uses Red when he travels from [[Tremonsien]] to [[Cairhien]]{{ref/book|2|25}} and later across [[Toman Head]]{{ref/book|2|41}} and into [[Falme]].{{ref/book|2|45}} When [[Matrim Cauthon]] blows the Horn of Valere, Rand is confronted by [[Ishamael|Ba'alzamon]] and is thrown from Red's saddle. After this, Red disappears.{{ref/book|2|47}}
